proofs.text: Run init and verify the shim's text contains neither this checkout's path, nor the project's path, nor the contents of the `VERSION` file

rule_text: The shim names no machine, no checkout and no release, so the file is right for every clone and everything machine-specific is resolved when it runs

tests.body:
def test_the_shim_names_no_machine(self, project):
        project.run('--gate', 'tested')
        shim = read(project.path('.purlin/hooks/pre-push'))
        assert ROOT not in shim
        assert project.root not in shim
tests.name: test_the_shim_names_no_machine

tests.body:
def test_the_shim_names_no_machine_and_no_release(self, passing):
        shim = read(passing.path('.purlin/hooks/pre-push'))
        assert ROOT not in shim
        assert passing.root not in shim
        assert read(os.path.join(ROOT, 'VERSION')).strip() not in shim
tests.name: test_the_shim_names_no_machine_and_no_release
reasons: expected value computed by same function as SUT
